name: Posoria – Point of Sale (POS) for WooCommerce
author: posoria

sections.description:
Posoria is a free WooCommerce point of sale (POS) for retail shops, boutiques, and online stores that also sell in person. It runs inside your existing WordPress admin, rings up sales from your existing WooCommerce products, and creates a real WooCommerce order for every sale — so your stock, taxes, and reports all stay in one place.

Watch Posoria in action

No order limits. No trial timer. No license key. Posoria is fully self-hosted: it does not phone home and does not send your data to any external service.

Built for reliability. Many POS plugins create conflicts — duplicate orders, stock that drifts, or sales with no order and no payment recorded. Posoria does not. Every sale is created through WooCommerce’s own order API, so stock is reduced correctly, the payment is recorded, and the order appears in WooCommerce exactly like an online order. It has been tested across many live stores and is production-ready, even though it is fully self-hosted.

Why store owners choose Posoria

  • Built on WooCommerce — your products, orders, taxes and reports stay native
  • Fast, touch-friendly screen for tablet and desktop
  • Every in-store sale is a normal WooCommerce order (HPOS-compatible)
  • No conflicts: correct stock, recorded payments, no duplicate orders
  • One source of truth — no separate POS database to reconcile

Features included (free)

  • Touch-friendly POS screen for tablet and desktop
  • Cash payments with automatic change calculation
  • Manual card payments — record card sales without a connected terminal
  • Apply coupon codes to a sale at checkout
  • Hold and recall sales — park a cart and come back to it later
  • Create custom products on the fly, straight from the POS screen
  • Cash in / cash out — track petty-cash movements during a shift
  • Real WooCommerce orders created for every sale (HPOS-compatible)
  • End-of-shift Z-Report and register close with cash count
  • Multiple registers and multiple cashiers
  • Dedicated cashier role with a branded login at /posoria
  • WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks compatibility declared
  • Translation-ready (text domain: posoria)

Works for almost any WooCommerce store

Posoria fits fashion and apparel, electronics, hardware, beauty and cosmetics, books, gifts, homeware, sporting goods and more — essentially any business selling physical products in person.

  • Retail shops and boutiques
  • Pop-up stores, market stalls and events
  • Showrooms, warehouses and trade counters
  • Any WooCommerce store that also sells face to face

POSORIA Pro (optional, sold separately)

Posoria is complete on its own. If you later need more, POSORIA Pro is a separate paid plugin available at posoria.com. It is not required and is not part of this free download. Pro adds tools such as thermal receipt printing, mid-shift X-Reports, card terminals, suppliers and purchase orders, a customers CRM, returns and refunds, advanced reports, PDF invoices, and offline sync.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 8.0 or later.
  2. Install Posoria from the WordPress plugin directory (or upload the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin).
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to POSORIA → Cashiers and create one or more cashier accounts.
  5. Go to POSORIA → Registers and confirm your registers.
  6. Open /posoria/ on your site (or click Open POS from the POSORIA dashboard) and start selling.
sections.faq:
Does Posoria require WooCommerce?

Yes. Posoria is a WooCommerce extension. WooCommerce 8.0 or later must be installed and active.

Is Posoria compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Every POS sale is written through the standard WooCommerce order API, and HPOS plus Cart & Checkout Blocks compatibility are declared on activation.

Will Posoria conflict with my WooCommerce orders, stock or payments?

No. Posoria does not run a parallel system. Each sale is created through WooCommerce’s own order API, so stock is reduced correctly, the payment is recorded, and the order appears in WooCommerce just like any other order. No duplicate orders, no stock drift, nothing to reconcile. Posoria has been tested on many live stores.

Is there really no order limit?

Correct. Posoria has no daily order cap, no trial timer, and no license key. Everything in this download stays free and fully usable.

Can cashiers use the POS without full admin access?

Yes. Posoria adds a dedicated cashier role. Cashiers can sign in at /posoria/ but cannot reach the rest of the WordPress admin.

Where is my sales data stored?

In your own WordPress database. Sales are real WooCommerce orders, so they appear in standard WooCommerce reports. Posoria adds its own tables only for register sessions and stock movements.

Does Posoria connect to any external service?

No. The free plugin is fully self-hosted. It does not contact Stripe, Square, or any other third-party API, and it sends no telemetry. Connected card terminals are part of the separate POSORIA Pro plugin.

What happens when I uninstall?

By default your data is kept, so reinstalling restores everything. To remove Posoria’s tables and settings on delete, enable Delete all POSORIA data on uninstall under POSORIA → Settings → General → Advanced first. Your WooCommerce orders and products are never deleted.

Why is the plugin folder named “posoria”?

The folder name matches the translation text domain (posoria). The plugin name shown on the Plugins screen is still Posoria.
